A sample afternoon on a west-wall condenser, start to finish.

Job ticket · west-wall condenserSample ticket
  1. 2:14 PM

    Arrived

    Fan grille checked for debris; disconnect pulled before opening the panel. Booties on at the threshold.

    A · fan guard
  2. 2:28 PM

    Reading & cause

    Suction 68 PSI, superheat 12°. Run capacitor swollen; the meter reads microfarads below the nameplate. Written here so you see what we saw. Sample reading

    B · run capacitor
  3. 3:05 PM

    New capacitor in, drain pan tested with water, system restarted and temperatures checked at the registers.

While you wait

Six things that help until the truck arrives.

  1. Close blinds on west-facing windows.
  2. Check the breaker and the outdoor disconnect.
  3. Set the fan to ON to move air (won’t cool, but helps).
  4. If ice is visible, turn cooling OFF and leave fan ON to thaw.
  5. Keep pets hydrated and away from the outdoor unit.
  6. Text us your address so dispatch can route the nearest tech.
